news.analysis: Allen opened the scoring with a one-yard rush in first quarter and found DJ Moore and Dalton Kincaid on passing touchdowns to ice the game in the fourth quarter. Allen has at least two touchdowns in every game so far this season. He will look to continue to build on his strong start to the season against the Vikings in Week 9.
news.contents: Josh Allen completed 21-of-34 passes for 289 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception in a 36-10 win over the Ravens. He rushed for 30 yards and a touchdown on seven attempts.
news.title: Josh Allen accounts for three touchdowns in Week 8 win

news.contents: Buffalo Bills quarterback Josh Allen completed 21 of his 34 pass attempts for 289 passing yards, two passing touchdowns, and one interception during Sunday's Week 8 win over the Baltimore Ravens. He also boosted his fantasy output with seven rushing attempts, 30 rushing yards, and one rushing touchdown. news.analysis: Allen set a new career high in rushing yards and has been excellent as the starting running back with Breece Hall (quad) out for the fifth straight game. Allen has tallied over 100 rushing yards in three of those five games and will likely remain a key part of the Jets' offense in Week 9 against the Chiefs.
news.contents: Braelon Allen rushed for 147 yards and a touchdown on 21 carries in a 38-33 loss to the Raiders. He caught both of his targets for six yards.
news.title: Braelon Allen excellent in Week 8 loss

news.contents: New York Jets running back Braelon Allen delivered 23.3 PPR fantasy points in Sunday's 38-33 loss to the Las Vegas Raiders, rushing 21 times for a season-high 147 yards and a touchdown. Allen had already piled up 121 rushing yards by halftime before breaking loose for a 21-yard score in the third quarter. He also caught both of his targets for six yards, while fellow running back Isaiah Davis managed just 15 yards on five carries. Allen has now received at least 17 carries in four consecutive ...
news.title: Braelon Allen Delivers RB1-Level Fantasy Production in Week 8

news.analysis: Johnson saw a total of six touches on Monday with Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) still out for the Bears. He wasn't able to do much with his limited work, however, finishing with just 28 total yards in the team's win over Seattle. He remains off of the fantasy radar at this point in the season.
news.contents: Roschon Johnson rushed the ball five times for 17 yards and caught one pass for 11 yards in Monday's 34-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
news.title: Roschon Johnson quiet in win Monday

news.analysis: Boston was second only behind Harold Fannin on the team in targets. He was unable to turn any of them into big gains. He remains on the WR3/WR4 radar for fantasy managers as a volatile week-to-week play.

news.analysis: Mayer and Brock Bowers led the Raiders' pass catchers, accounting for 16 of Kirk Cousins' 26 pass attempts. Mayer remains a solid option in deeper leagues with the Raiders' continuing to deploy both tight ends.

news.analysis: Reichard struggled to make an impact Sunday, registering less than nine points for the first time in his last six contests. The kicker will look to get back on track against the Buffalo Bills in Week 9.

news.analysis: In one of the weirder games you may ever see, Penix threw almost as many interceptions as completions. Meanwhile Baker Mayfield did not commit a single pass in a win. Penix will be a QB2 play next week against the Bengals.

Williams becomes interesting in fantasy moving forward as he gears up to take on the Rams in Week 9.
